```yaml
name: Sync AI connector docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Airbyte repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: ai-connectors
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Git user
        run: |
          git config user.name "Octavia Bot"
          git config user.email "octavia-bot@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Sync AI connector docs
        run: |
          SRC_DIR="ai-connectors"
          DEST_DIR="docs/ai-agents/connectors"
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          for connector in "$SRC_DIR"*/; do
            if [ -d "$connector" ]; then
              for md_file in "$connector"*.md; do
                if [ -f "$md_file" ]; then
                  cp "$md_file" "$DEST_DIR"
                fi
              done
            fi
          done

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Generate Octavia token
        id: generate-token
        uses: octavia/octavia-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.generate-token.outputs.token }}
          commit-message: "chore: sync AI connector docs"
          title: "chore: sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            Automated sync of AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors.
          branch: "sync-ai-connector-docs"
          base: "main"
          labels: "documentation,auto-merge"
          delete-branch: true
```
